nom: La Roche-Posay Effaclar BPO Multi-Target Acne Treatment

concerns.spots: Reviewers describe deep, painful hormonal acne and whiteheads/blackheads clearing up within days to two weeks of daily use; one notes a visible difference overnight.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers report their breakouts clearing or improving significantly, including hormonal acne that had not responded to other products; one reviewer also saw reduced redness alongside fewer breakouts.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product cleared up most of her redness within less than a week of use.

extraits.texte: I was having a terrible breakout of hormonal acne. Every morning I was waking up to a new pimple that was deep under the skin and very painful. I started applying this once a day in the morning, let it dry completely, then followed up with moisturizer and spf, and my acne was completely gone after two weeks. I love this stuff and will continue to use it as a spot treatment. Also, during those two weeks, there were some days I skipped using this treatment because it was very drying so just be careful because it's STRONG.

I previously used the Obagi Clenziderm therapeutic lotion which had benzoyl peroxide but I wasn't willing to pay that price anymore. This does the same job if not better and cleared my face up in a matter of days

i never leave reviews however ive been struggling with small whiteheads and blackheads, as well as hormonal acne for months now and nothing has worked. ive been using this for less than a week now and it has already cleared up most of my redness and acne. i am very impressed and excited to see how it goes for the next few weeks
this treatment has helped my hormonal acne so much, it started to show a huge difference overnight. highly recommend!!!

reserve: Only five short reviews are available and none specify the reviewer's skin type, so segment-level claims by skin type cannot be made; conclusions rely mainly on concern-level reports.
